description: Load one Edgegap agent skill: its SKILL.md (the workflow to follow) by default, or one of its reference documents or templates with file. Load the matching skill before acting on a game project — edgegap-ngo for Unity with Netcode for GameObjects, edgegap-fishnet for Unity with FishNet, edgegap-purrnet for Unity with PurrNet, edgegap-fusion for Unity with Photon Fusion 2, edgegap-unity for other Unity projects, edgegap-unreal for Unreal Engine (edgegap-eos-voice for voice chat), edgegap-fusion-simplefps for the Photon Simple FPS sample, edgegap-godot for Godot 4 with a Godot server, edgegap-colyseus for a Colyseus server, edgegap-nakama for a Nakama backend, edgegap-playfab for PlayFab Matchmaking, edgegap-threejs for a Three.js/browser game with a Node.js server, edgegap-manus for a browser game built with Manus, edgegap otherwise — and fetch the references and templates it points to as you reach them. No API call.

file.description: A file inside the skill, e.g. "references/deploy.md" or "assets/docker/Dockerfile". Default SKILL.md.

skill.description: Skill name, from edgegap_list_skills: edgegap, edgegap-colyseus, edgegap-containerize, edgegap-deployments-api, edgegap-eos-voice, edgegap-fishnet, edgegap-fusion, edgegap-fusion-simplefps, edgegap-godot, edgegap-launch, edgegap-local-testing, edgegap-manus, edgegap-nakama, edgegap-ngo, edgegap-playfab, edgegap-purrnet, edgegap-server-design, edgegap-threejs, edgegap-troubleshoot, edgegap-unity, edgegap-unreal.
